'''Kevin S. McGrew''' is an American psychologist and [[human intelligence|intelligence]] researcher. He is the founder and director of the Institute for Applied Psychometrics, as well as a visiting professor of [[educational psychology]] at the [[University of Minnesota]]. He was formerly Professor of Applied Psychology at [[St. Cloud State University]]. He is a co-author of Batteries III and IV of the [[Woodcock–Johnson Tests of Cognitive Abilities]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://themindhub.com/7-pages/33-meet-dr-kevin-mcgrew-phd |title=Meet Dr. Kevin McGrew, PHD |website=The MindHub |access-date=2019-07-24}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.iapsych.com/mcgrewvita.pdf |title=Kevin S. McGrew, Ph.D. CV |date=2018-10-21 |website=Institute for Applied Psychometrics |access-date=2019-07-23}}</ref> In 2016, he received the [[University of Minnesota College of Education and Human Development]]'s Distinguished Alumni Award.<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.sctimes.com/story/money/business/2016/12/16/business/95475518/ |title=In business |date=2016-12-16 |work=SC Times |access-date=2019-07-24 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.cehd.umn.edu/alumni/distinguished/deans-2016/ |title=2016 CEHD Distinguished Alumni Award Recipients  |website=University of Minnesota College of Education and Human Development |language=en |access-date=2019-07-24}}</ref>
